cases.name: observed_plain_loopback_cookie_jar
cases.source:
WFM_HOSTED_STAGING=true
curl -c /tmp/employee.cookie -H 'X-Forwarded-Proto: https' --data '{}' http://127.0.0.1:3000/api/login
curl -b /tmp/employee.cookie -H 'X-Forwarded-Proto: https' http://127.0.0.1:3000/api/bootstrap

cases.name: canonical_explicit_loopback_session
cases.source:
WFM_HOSTED_STAGING=true
curl -D /tmp/login.headers -H 'X-Forwarded-Proto: https' --data '{}' http://127.0.0.1:3000/api/login
grep -qi '^set-cookie: .*Secure' /tmp/login.headers
cookie=$(awk '/^set-cookie:/ {print $2}' /tmp/login.headers | cut -d';' -f1)
curl -H "Cookie: $cookie" -H 'X-Forwarded-Proto: https' http://127.0.0.1:3000/api/bootstrap

cases.name: external_plain_http_explicit_cookie
cases.source:
WFM_HOSTED_STAGING=true
curl -D /tmp/login.headers --data '{}' http://staging.example.test/api/login
grep -qi '^set-cookie: .*Secure' /tmp/login.headers
cookie=$(awk '/^set-cookie:/ {print $2}' /tmp/login.headers)
curl -H "Cookie: $cookie" http://staging.example.test/api/bootstrap
